proofs.text: Run `--gate approved` and verify the output holds none of the retired terms and no character at or above U+1F000; read `scripts/hooks/pre-push.sh` and verify it holds none of them either

rule_text: Nothing init prints, and nothing in the hook script it installs, carries an emoji or a term this release retired

tests.body:
def test_no_emoji_and_no_retired_word_in_the_output(self, project):
        output = project.run('--gate', 'approved')
        # Spelled in halves so this file does not carry the words either.
        for word in ('rece' + 'ipt', 'au' + 'dit', 'CODE' + 'OWNERS',
                     'fo' + 'rge', 'plat' + 'form'):
            assert word not in output.lower()
        assert all(ord(ch) < 0x1F000 for ch in output)
